# SOP-P2-L4-02 Product changeover - Heat Treat line

Revision: Rev C  
Plant: P2, line P2-L4  
Equipment: EQ-P2-L4-RR01, EQ-P2-L4-HT02, EQ-P2-L4-HP03

Purpose
1. Provide step-by-step procedure for product changeover on the Heat Treat line (load, furnace, press) to maintain metallurgical integrity, repeatability, and safety.

Scope
2. Applies to operators, lead technicians, and maintenance personnel performing changeover on EQ-P2-L4-RR01, EQ-P2-L4-HT02, and EQ-P2-L4-HP03. Follow referenced documents: ECN-2026-045, MM-P2-L4-RR01, SOP-P2-L4-03.

Preconditions
3. Only start changeover when production schedule authorizes change and ECN-2026-045 showing approved product configuration is available at the workstation. Verify incoming billets/forgings match ECN-2026-045 disposition before processing.

PPE
4. Required personal protective equipment for all personnel involved:
   - Cut-resistant gloves rated for hot handling tasks.
   - Heat-resistant face shield and apron when loading/unloading furnace or handling fresh parts.
   - Safety footwear with metatarsal protection.
   - Hearing protection in the RR01 and press zones.
   - Arc-rated clothing where indicated by SOP-P2-L4-03.
5. All PPE must be inspected per MM-P2-L4-RR01 before use and recorded on the maintenance log.

Safety limits and critical settings
6. The austenitizing setpoint for Heat Treat heat treat furnace #2 (EQ-P2-L4-HT02) is 885 °C.
7. The system pressure limit for Heat Treat hydraulic forging press #3 (EQ-P2-L4-HP03) is 320 bar.
8. Do not override safety interlocks during changeover. Any attempt to bypass will require stop, lockout, and escalation to maintenance per MM-P2-L4-RR01.

Changeover steps (numbered sequence)
9. Prepare and verify documentation
   1. Retrieve ECN-2026-045 and confirm target material, process route, and any special instructions.
   2. Confirm prior-run records and batch IDs match handover sheet. Attach ECN-2026-045 copy to the changeover record.
   3. Notify downstream inspectors and quality that a changeover is starting; list expected checkpoints from SOP-P2-L4-03.
10. Isolate and secure equipment
   1. Stop feed to EQ-P2-L4-RR01 and confirm line empty per MM-P2-L4-RR01 isolation checklist.
   2. Place required lockout/tagout devices on electrical and hydraulic sources for EQ-P2-L4-HT02 and EQ-P2-L4-HP03 before mechanical adjustments.
11. Clean and inspect
   1. Clean loading chutes, furnace chamber access, and press dies of debris and scale. Use approved wire brushes and vacuum extraction per MM-P2-L4-RR01.
   2. Inspect furnace elements and door seals visually; document any abnormalities on the equipment log. If abnormal condition present, notify maintenance and do not proceed.
12. Install tooling and fixturing
   1. Mount new die or carrier assemblies on EQ-P2-L4-HP03 following manufacturer mounting points; verify clamping interfaces are free of burrs.
   2. For rolling or feed fixtures on EQ-P2-L4-RR01, reference MM-P2-L4-RR01 for alignment tolerances and secure per its checklist.
13. Configure furnace
   1. Clear furnace program cache, then load program that corresponds to ECN-2026-045 for the new product batch.
   2. Confirm and document the control displays show the target austenitizing setpoint. The austenitizing setpoint for Heat Treat heat treat furnace #2 (EQ-P2-L4-HT02) is 885 °C.
   3. Do not modify the setpoint without authorized ECN revision.
14. Configure press
   1. Verify hydraulic system pressure indications are within normal readiness range before release from lockout.
   2. Confirm the system pressure limit for Heat Treat hydraulic forging press #3 (EQ-P2-L4-HP03) is 320 bar and ensure the pressure relief setpoints are not altered.
   3. Inspect hoses and fittings and sign off on the prestart hydraulic checklist.
15. Dry-run and verification
   1. Perform a dry-run with empty carriers through EQ-P2-L4-RR01 and without heat or material through the press cycle to verify mechanical timing and clearances.
   2. Run a single instrumented trial piece per SOP-P2-L4-03 sampling plan for metallurgical verification. Note: instrumentation must be installed and removed per MM-P2-L4-RR01 procedures.
16. Production release
   1. If trial piece passes inspection criteria and all checklists are complete, release the line for production. Attach trial piece results and ECN-2026-045 to the batch record.
   2. If trial piece fails, record failure modes, retain trial material, and initiate corrective action per SOP-P2-L4-03.

Records to keep
17. Maintain the following documents in the changeover folder:
   - Copy of ECN-2026-045 used for this changeover.
   - Completed MM-P2-L4-RR01 checklists for RR01 and verification signoffs.
   - Furnace program save file and confirmation showing the austenitizing setpoint for EQ-P2-L4-HT02.
   - Hydraulic prestart checklist and pressure verification showing the system pressure limit for EQ-P2-L4-HP03.
   - Trial piece inspection report and any nonconformance records.
   - Operator and lead sign-off pages for this SOP.

Examples and rationale
18. Example: If ECN-2026-045 specifies a different alloy requiring alternate quench handling, the changeover must include the alternate quench container setup and documented training for operators. This prevents metallurgical defects due to improper cooling.
19. Rationale: Verifying furnace setpoint and press pressure limits ensures repeatable phase transformations and avoids over-stressing press components. Lockout and documented verification reduce risk of tooling damage and personal injury.

Deviations
20. Any deviation from this SOP requires documented management approval and a revision to ECN-2026-045 or an attached work instruction per SOP-P2-L4-03.

PPE and sign-off
21. Sign-off block (to be completed by responsible personnel)
   - Operator name / signature / time
   - Lead technician name / signature / time
   - Quality inspector name / signature / time
22. Final acceptance: Production Supervisor signs to indicate release complete and records filed.

Related documents
23. See ECN-2026-045, MM-P2-L4-RR01, SOP-P2-L4-03 for supporting procedures, tooling lists, and inspection criteria.
